children: Erdberg Daniyel, a 10% owner and Chairman and CEO, sold 1,000,000 shares of common stock at $4.00 per share. The total sale amount was $4,000,000. Following the transaction, Erdberg Daniyel directly owns 3,749,058 shares of common stock. The filing notes the private sale granted the purchaser a two-year right to buy an additional 1,000,000 shares at $6.00 per share and that the reporter beneficially owns additional shares through DL2 Capital LLC (470,000) and Erdberg Foundation Inc. (178,000).
